changes.comment: BREAKING: executeClientToolTurn pre-flights every client tool's parameter schema for the target wire when the turn is created; a schema the wire cannot carry now returns a Failure naming the tool, the path and the wire, with nothing sent, instead of surfacing as a stream `error` event once the turn runs.

New `verifiedEndpoint: { providerId, verified: true }` (AiAssist.IAiVerifiedEndpoint) on callProviderCompletion, callProviderCompletionStream, executeClientToolTurn, clientToolSchemaKeywords and structuredOutputSchemaKeywords: an endpoint override asserted to be the descriptor's own provider gets that provider's keyword table (the ft: rule included) instead of the conservative one. Ignored unless `verified` is the literal true and `providerId` equals the descriptor id.
`default` is now dropped, not folded, on the OpenAI/xAI table and on every unverified wire: a folded `Default: ...` read as though the default were applied. `format` and `examples` still fold.
Anthropic tools refuse a typeless root schema (observed live: 400 input_schema.type Field required); `{}` beneath the root still passes. Applies to client tools and to forced-tool structured output.
